verdict.rationale: Docs describe a plain-language input ('Users can't tell which invoices are overdue') that starts an intention, which the system fills in with agreed purpose and deliverables, and then proposes concrete tasks that agents claim and execute against a repo, matching intent-to-spec flow. Approval gating and status tracking further support this being a scoped, reviewable task pipeline rather than free-form chat. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of task scoping quality and no example showing the full transformed task output text.
